Definition: Jigal, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Igal is the name of three Israelites, a spy, a mighty man and a son of Shemaiah. In Numbers 13:7, Igal the son of Joseph. The fuller story is told on the Igal, Son of Joseph profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that Igal is named at all, which tells me God sees individuals, not only crowds.
